scope.primary: Kaggle-driven retail shock simulation; native benchmarks in legacy appendix only
scope.implementation_claim: Protocol and sampling only; branch execution remains Milestone 2 work

research_questions.question: Does the composite LLM policy improve contribution relative to adaptive under shocks?
Does explicit updated history improve the composite policy response?
How much repair, fallback, latency and API expense does the policy require?
Do conclusions persist under matched changes in price elasticity?

dataset.prior_inspection: Previously used source data; no pristine unseen-data claim

sampling.selection: Exclude legacy series; sort eligible series by training sample CV then store and product; select floor(N*(i+0.5)/12) for i=0..11
sampling.statistic: Training Demand sample standard deviation ddof=1 divided by positive mean

branching.snapshot: Immediately before day 8; restore cash, stock, pipeline, prices, date, history, accounting and random state
branching.comparison: Share a prefix across all policies, histories and conditions within each series/window/assumption setting
branching.randomness: Match exogenous demand; restore RNG state where present; provider seeds do not guarantee identical model responses
branching.estimand: Policy takeover from a common adaptive warm-up state, rather than deployment from day 1

history_variants.frozen: History available at end of day 7, unchanged after split
history_variants.none: Empty explicit history field; retain current operational state

policies.history_interpretation: Composite-policy information dependence; current state still contains consequences of the past
policies.no_repair_ablation: Deferred; requires separately frozen policy and complete trajectory execution

model.realization_interpretation: Repeated requests measure observed provider variability even at temperature zero; not independent businesses

failure_policy.invalid_after_repair: Adaptive action from the same treated observation; retain fallback in primary outcomes
failure_policy.transport_or_budget_failure: Stop incomplete; preserve charges and attempts; no invented fallback
failure_policy.missing_pairs: Report incomplete; do not present unpaired results as a complete matrix
failure_policy.retry: Explicit reviewed resume/restart with cumulative ledger; never silently duplicate a paid decision

simulator.sensitivity: Fresh full-history LLM and both baselines; match branches within each elasticity setting
simulator.holding_and_terminal_value_sensitivity: Deferred secondary extensions; valuation-only recalculation is not behavioral robustness

analysis.primary_outcome: Sum of contribution over days 8 through 21
analysis.contribution_definition: Revenue minus cost of goods sold and holding cost in unspecified simulator monetary units
analysis.primary_contrast: LLM shock contribution minus adaptive shock contribution, separately per shock
analysis.history_contrasts: Full minus frozen and full minus none under each condition; also compare shock-minus-control differences

recovery.criterion: Zero lost sales and inventory within 20% of max(own paired-control closing inventory, 1) on each qualifying day

analysis.aggregation: Average LLM realizations within series-window-condition; report equal-weight block summaries per scenario and within-block variation separately
analysis.dependence: Shared stores, products, dates and controls; 36 series-window blocks are not guaranteed independent
analysis.inference: Descriptive mean, median, range, sign counts and individual contrasts; no confidence intervals or population significance claims
analysis.reliability_denominators: Separate scheduled opportunities, completed decisions, first responses, repair attempts, successful repairs, fallback days and missing decisions
analysis.intervention_attribution: Valid-day versus fallback-day contrasts are descriptive; no causal component attribution

cohorts.main: 12 series x 3 windows x 4 conditions x 3 LLM realizations; full history; reference elasticity
cohorts.history: 6 preselected series x all windows x 4 conditions x 3 realizations; frozen and none; reuse main full-history branches
cohorts.elasticity: Same 6 series x all windows x 4 conditions x 3 realizations; full history at 0.75 and 2.25; both baselines
cohorts.development: Two validation cases x 4 conditions x 3 histories x 1 realization; reference elasticity
cohorts.production_scope: Planning ceiling; measured pilot and manual budget handoff required; amendments precede outcome inspection

reviewer_mapping.evidence: Frozen manifest plus complete cohort distributions
Prefix equality audits and history contrasts
reviewer_mapping.status: Protocol prepared; implementation and experiments pending

reviewer_mapping.evidence: Decision provenance and reconciled intervention denominators
Retail-focused report and verified upstream comparison
reviewer_mapping.status: Scope fixed; writing and reference audit pending

reviewer_mapping.evidence: Block-level descriptive analysis with dependency audit

milestones.deliverable: Matched-prefix runner, histories and offline invariant tests
milestones.review_gate: User reviews code and manual pilot handoff

milestones.deliverable: Development pilot audit and budget proposal
milestones.review_gate: User runs pilot and reviews measured cost and exact matrix

milestones.deliverable: Economic, history, reliability and sensitivity analysis

amendments: Retain versions and explain changes before evaluation outcome inspection; no tuning selection, prompts, exclusions or metrics on evaluation outcomes

storage.tracked: Code, protocol and compact sampling inputs under configs/report2
storage.local: Plans and review notes under docs; experiment evidence under ignored results/report2
storage.secrets: Local environment only; no account details, conversations or credentials in Git
